timetableP: Classes run across the full 5AM–11PM window, seven days a week. Book your spot on WhatsApp — it lands directly with the team.
trainersP: Certified coaches run every session on the floor — strength, conditioning and mobility. Meet them on a trial visit.
membershipP: Three tiers from ₹2,999/month, with annual plans saving 2 months, corporate plans available, and EMI options on all plans. QR check-in and member portal included.
facilitiesP: Premium AC environment with ventilation, open 18 hours a day, 7 days a week — early birds and night owls covered.
recoveryP: Recovery and spa access plus quarterly health checkups on premium tiers.
fourthPanelP: 18 hours a day, 7 days a week. Guest passes on annual tiers.
trialP: Book a free trial, tour the floor, find your tribe — then decide with total clarity.
